mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_COUPON_ID, O.GUEST_NAME, O.GUEST_PHONE, D.DELIVERY_ID, D.DELIVERY_STATUS, D.TRACKING_NO, D.SHIPPED_AT, D.DELIVERED_AT, D.PICKED_UP_AT, D.RECEIVER_NAME, D.ADDRESS, D.ORDER_ID AS D_ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN PAYMENT PAY ON PAY.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND PAY.PAY_STATUS IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED') LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON O.ORDER_ID = D.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.GUEST_NAME = #{guestName} AND O.GUEST_PHONE = #{guestPhone} AND O.USER_ID LIKE 'GUEST_%' AND ( PAY.PAY_STATUS IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED') OR O.ORDER_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' )

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_COUPON_ID, O.GUEST_NAME, O.GUEST_PHONE, D.DELIVERY_ID, D.DELIVERY_STATUS, D.TRACKING_NO, D.SHIPPED_AT, D.DELIVERED_AT, D.PICKED_UP_AT, D.RECEIVER_NAME, D.ADDRESS, D.ORDER_ID AS D_ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN PAYMENT PAY ON PAY.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND PAY.PAY_STATUS IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED') LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON O.ORDER_ID = D.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.USER_ID LIKE 'GUEST_%' AND ( PAY.PAY_STATUS IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED') OR O.ORDER_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' )

SELECT OI.ITEM_ID AS itemId, OI.ORDER_ID AS orderId, OI.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, OI.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, OI.QUANTITY AS quantity, OI.START_DATE AS startDate, OI.END_DATE AS endDate,
GROUP_CONCAT( POV.OPTION_VALUE ORDER BY POV.OPTION_GROUP_ID, POV.SORT_ORDER SEPARATOR ' / ' ) AS optionName,
(SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM ORDER_ITEM OI LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_ITEM POI ON OI.OPTION_ITEM_ID = POI.OPTION_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_ITEM_VALUE POIV ON POI.OPTION_ITEM_ID = POIV.OPTION_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE POV ON POIV.OPTION_VALUE_ID = POV.OPTION_VALUE_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} GROUP BY OI.ITEM_ID, OI.ORDER_ID, OI.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.UNIT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, OI.START_DATE, OI.END_DATE ORDER BY OI.ITEM_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_EXCHANGE ( ORDER_ID, USER_ID, EXCHANGE_REASON, REASON_DETAIL, EXCHANGE_METHOD, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, DETAIL_ADDRESS, MEMO, EXCHANGE_STATUS, CREATED_AT ) SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.USER_ID, #{exchangeReason}, #{reasonDetail}, #{exchangeMethod}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{memo}, 'REQUESTED', NOW() FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.USER_ID LIKE 'GUEST_%'
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = 'EXCHANGE_REQUESTED' WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND USER_ID LIKE 'GUEST_%'
mapper.select: SELECT R.RENTAL_ID FROM RENTALS R JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
